messages.subject: Aaron | GCC Mining, Metals & Industrial Executive Profile | ESG & Government Relations
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Ashton,

I am sharing my profile for senior GCC and international leadership mandates across mining, metals, materials and industrial businesses.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio covers senior government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

Your work from Dubai across MENA on senior executive assignments in metals, mining, minerals, process industries and manufacturing makes my background directly relevant to searches where leaders must combine government interface, sustainability, stakeholder trust and complex operating execution.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE.

I have attached my GCC-focused executive CV for confidential consideration. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
